toplevel.title: General Settings
toplevel.context_window_desc: Default context window used when taking over Claude Code / Codex; auto-compaction triggers at ~90%. Defaults to 200000 — a larger window is not always better (higher cost and more context drift). To set a value above 200000, you must also enable 'Extended Context (1M)' for the corresponding model family in the router (appends [1m] to the model name); otherwise Claude Code caps it at 200000 and the setting has no effect.
toplevel.context_window_warn: Value exceeds 200000 but the model family's 'Extended Context (1M)' is not enabled. Claude Code caps it at 200000, so this setting won't take effect — enable Extended Context in the router.
toplevel.probe_timeout_desc: Hard timeout for background provider reachability probes. Default 15000.
toplevel.probe_slow_threshold_desc: When a provider probe takes longer than this, the UI shows a yellow slow-network warning. Affects UI cues only, not routing or the circuit breaker. Default 3000.
toplevel.custom_router_path_placeholder: Enter absolute path to custom router script file

A client-set level always wins.

router.title: Router
router.enableExtendedContextDesc: Append [1m] to the Claude Code model name for 1M context window support. Only when enabled can the top-level 'Context Window' be set above 200000 (e.g. 400000) — Claude Code then caps it at 1M and compaction triggers at the configured value; without this, any value above 200000 is capped back to 200000.

projects.ccr_takeover_desc: When enabled, this project's Claude Code CLI routes requests through ccr by writing ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN into .claude/settings.local.json.
projects.takeover_clients_desc: Choose which clients this project takes over; only Claude Code is taken over by default. pi / Qwen Code / opencode are opt-in (they write config files such as .pi/settings.json, .qwen/settings.json and opencode.json into the project directory).
